meta.title: Social Platforms by Country
meta.grain: one row per country x platform
meta.measures: share of page-view referrals among tracked social platforms
meta.critical_caveat: MESSAGING APPS ARE NOT MEASURED. WhatsApp/Telegram/WeChat/Signal/Viber generate few web referrals but may be THE dominant channel in several of these countries. A low total here means little web-referral traffic, NOT that people are offline.
meta.empty_month_note: The CURRENT month publishes as all-zeros before StatCounter finalises it; the parser walks BACK to the last month with real data and records which month that was.

source.name: StatCounter GlobalStats
source.licence: StatCounter GlobalStats — free for use with attribution
source.measures: share of page-view referrals by social platform
source.does_not_measure: messaging apps (WhatsApp/Telegram/WeChat/Signal/Viber) — they generate few web referrals but may be the DOMINANT channel
